rationale: Ground truth is a rubber-stamp LGTM with four minor nits (two already resolved via 'move to utils'), which neither candidate hits directly, though X's nod to is_interleaved and Y's nod to PureDiffusionLauncherAdapter each loosely validate one already-fixed item. X's headline 'blocking' double-seed/engine-crash claim and its Qwen2.5-Omni breakage claim are unverifiable, unusually severe for a merged/approved PR guarded by a purpose-built four-case test suite, and read as overreach dressed as fact ('I reproduced it'). Y is more calibrated (Approve-with-follow-ups matches actual merge state) and both independently converge on the same real findings (dead async_tokens_to_discard writes, red non-CUDA CI gates, compile-cache isolation gaps), which corroborates those specific items and favors Y's more disciplined precision.
